author: BandaBanda
quote:
GTA 6 looks incredible. There. I said the nice thing. 

The writing feels like somebody pitched a Bonnie-and-Clyde story and then forgot to give Clyde a spine. There’s plenty of room in GTA for a woman who runs the show. It’d just be more fun if her partner had a personality beyond “whatever you say, babe.”

Then there’s the sandbox. If some NPCs really are off-limits but you can still shoot Grandma in the middle of the street, what exactly is the rule here? GTA used to let you do something awful to ANYONE and send the cops after you. That was the appeal of GTA. It was lawless and no one was safe. Half the fun of GTA was finding out what happened when you did something stupid. 

Even the dialogue sounds like it’s trying to get invited back to dinner. GTA used to be vulgar, petty, and happy to make everybody look ridiculous. That was half its personality. Now the city looks more alive than ever, and the people talking in it sound like they’re on their best behavior. 

The dialogue’s been scrubbed, the satire’s lost its bite, and the puddles look incredible. Great. I can see the reflection of the game I used to like.

Look at who’s writing today’s biggest games and you’ll start to see why so many of them sound the same. As long as studios keep hiring with the same worldview, we’re going to keep getting the same crap with better graphics.
